title: Phasix Mesh Underlay During Loop Ileostomy Closure
official: Phasix Mesh Underlay During Loop Ileostomy Closure: A Single Center Prospective Trial
summary: This prospective study will evaluate whether placement of long-acting absorbable Phasix mesh during loop ileostomy closure reduces the development of an incisional hernia at the ileostomy closure site in patients with a BMI greater than 25. Participants will undergo mesh-reinforced closure and will be followed for two years after surgery. The primary outcome is development of an incisional hernia at the ileostomy closure site, confirmed by CT imaging at two years.
conditions: Incisional Hernia of Anterior Abdominal Wall
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 18 years or older
* History of creation of a loop ileostomy
* Presenting for loop ileostomy closure
* BMI greater than 25

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients involved in other clinical research trials
* Unable to close posterior rectus sheath
* Cannot consent or are unwilling to consent
* Belong to a vulnerable population group such as pediatric patients, prisoners, pregnant patients, individuals with limited English proficiency, visually impaired individuals, or non-readers
* Patients with prohibitive medical risk including congestive heart failure, renal failure, or liver failure, based on the discretion of the principal investigator and operating surgeon
* Allergy to tetracycline hydrochloride or kanamycin sulfate
* Women planning to become pregnant during study participation has context menu
